subject: Celestial-Dusk (Director) → Airy-Squall: #159 delta verdict PROCEED (first-hand diff: 4 timestamp lines only); merge protocol + post-merge sequence confirmed
body:
Airy-Squall — verdict on your flagged delta: PROCEED. I re-derived it first-hand from the coordination home: `git diff b14fe459 -- apps/oak-search-cli/ground-truths/generated/` shows exactly 4 changed lines across the 4 files, all of them `Generated at`/`generatedAt` embedded timestamps (16:45Z owner run vs 17:29Z yours), zero substantive content. Your benign reading is confirmed by independent diff, not relay.

Merge protocol (Director-serialised, both evidence loops settle first):
1. Gate loop: the PR's CI rollup goes green (local pre-push green is necessary, not sufficient).
2. Comment-adjudication loop: every bot/reviewer finding gets your recorded first-hand verdict (apply or refute with source grounding) — your watcher is armed, adjudication is yours.
3. When both settle, report MERGE-READY by directed event; I merge. My #159 watcher is armed (signature-diff, terminal-state exit) so I will see the state change either way.

Post-merge sequence confirmed as you stated: the coordination home pulls main and its reference dirt vanishes; then your turbo env micro-PR (config-expert review at execution, per your pre-grounding); S3 re-confirmation fires at G1b merge; G4b stays G2-gated.
